# TemplateMo 621 Luminary

The landing page layout, stylesheet (`templatemo-621-luminary-style.css`), script
(`templatemo-621-luminary-script.js`) and the three images in `../images/` come from
**TemplateMo 621 Luminary** — https://templatemo.com/tm-621-luminary — and are used under the
TemplateMo licence, which requires the credit link to TemplateMo to stay in the page footer.
The images are from Unsplash (https://unsplash.com), credited in the footer as the template does.

Changes made here: the script guards the pricing-toggle and FAQ blocks so sections can be
omitted; all content, the brand and `../matelot.css` are ours.
